about: Gorilla Tag content read at runtime from the player's own Gorilla Tag folder. Nothing here is shipped; each row is located by the reader and rebuilt as a Unity object inside The Long Drive.

rows.match_rule: GameObject name contains 'gorilla' (case-insensitive) and mesh has >= 1 bone whose name contains 'hand'; prefer the one with most vertices
rows.used_for: source of the body mesh, its bones (names + parents) and its material's main texture
rows.fallback_if_missing: log 'GorillaDrive: gorilla rig not found' and keep the vanilla player (mod idles)
rows.verified: unverified: needs a Gorilla Tag install to confirm the match picks the player gorilla

rows.used_for: vertices, normals, uv0, triangles, bone weights, bind poses
rows.verified: unverified: vertex channel formats decoded per Unity 2019+ layout; compressed meshes not supported

rows.match_rule: first Material of gorilla_skin -> m_SavedProperties texture '_MainTex' or '_BaseMap'
rows.used_for: fur texture on body and hands
rows.fallback_if_missing: flat brown material (#5a3a22) so the gorilla still shows
rows.verified: unverified: supports RGBA32/ARGB32/RGB24/DXT1/DXT5/BC7 raw upload only

rows.match_rule: triangles whose vertices' dominant bone is the bone matching /hand.*(\.l|_l|left)/i or one of its descendants
rows.used_for: first-person left hand, posed in that bone's bind-pose space
rows.fallback_if_missing: hand drawn as a 0.12 m fur-textured sphere
rows.verified: unverified: bone naming in Gorilla Tag rig

rows.fallback_if_missing: hand drawn as a 0.12 m fur-textured sphere
rows.verified: unverified: bone naming in Gorilla Tag rig

rows.match_rule: all remaining triangles, bind pose (root space)
rows.used_for: gorilla body: shadow-only in first person, fully visible in third-person view
